_doc: Runtime-truth paths — potato is the source of truth for these while services run. Every wipe-capable script (git reset --hard, stash, PC push tarballs) MUST consult this file via scripts/linuxbox/protected-paths.py. Canonical contract: docs/runtime-state-protection.md.

types.versioned-json: JSON with monotonic top-level `version`; on restore keep local when local.version >= incoming.version
types.runtime-file: single file; local (on-box) copy always wins over git/tarball
types.runtime-dir: directory subtree; local copies always win; excluded from PC push tarballs

paths.note: GM roster truth; dashboard bumps version on every write
chat-threads, human-inbox, multitask-locks, run-index, watermarks — all box runtime
uploaded portrait images; big binaries — backed up separately, never git-owned
tableslop edit-mode drag+save writes on box; PC deploys via push-tableslop-map.sh scp (explicit wins)
